creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`dropping_the_handle_stops_the_thread` in `crates/muster-herdr/tests/subscription.rs` failed one full-gate run with `timed out after 10s waiting for the first bootstrap`, and passed on its own immediately afterwards. The gate runs several daemon-backed tests at once, each spawning its own herdr, so the deadline is against a daemon competing for the machine rather than against a broken subscription.

A flake in the gate is worse than a slow test: it teaches whoever hits it to re-run rather than to read. Either the deadline is sized for a loaded runner, or the test waits on something deterministic - the daemon answering ping - before starting to count.
title: 🧪 A subscription test times out under a loaded gate
